recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR-17790 follow-up is needed in core source; any separate editorial cleanup in the broader quantity-search text should be handled under its own tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-17790 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 MnM change request to clarify that Quantity search parameter unit system/code are optional and to add an example.
initial_application: The issue was applied by c9cc3457c79898ae7bc6ae6b2aec233eab1d2257, which updated source/search.html with optional system/code wording and a value-quantity=5.4 example. Later page restructuring preserved the substance in the current quantity search section.
additional_context: The originating Zulip thread confirms that Quantity units cannot be required because not all Quantity values carry units, and MnM WGM minutes corroborate the Persuasive disposition. Later FHIR-19597 clarified system-less quantity behavior in the same section but did not reverse the FHIR-17790 optional-unit rule. FHIR-17789 came from the same Zulip topic but concerned Observation search parameters and was later Resolved - No Change.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. Current source/search.html already lists [parameter]={[prefix]}[number], states that system and code are optional, and gives Observation?value-quantity=5.4 as matching irrespective of unit.
